applied.summary: Fixed technical error: the Q channel (not P and Q jointly) carries track/index numbers, timing/offsets, ISRCs, UPC/EAN, and pre-emphasis/copy flags; P is only a track-start/pause flag. Confirmed against Red Book / IEC 60908.

Replaced the horizontal-packing analogy ('writing smaller where the page is nearly full') with a vertical-depth image ('scooping a shallower channel'), so plain_english no longer reinforces the depth-vs-pitch confusion the entry's own common_mistakes warns against. FK 6.7.
Changed 'a picture of an audio's frequencies' to 'a sound's frequencies'; 'audio' used as a countable noun is nonstandard. FK 6.3.
Replaced duplicate disambiguation item 'TTS' (both 'Text-to-speech (TTS)' and 'TTS' were listed for one concept) with 'Automatic speech recognition (ASR)', VAD's real downstream partner.

Replaced two weakly relevant facility links ('Off-air monitor', 'News booth') with automation-family concepts ('Live assist system', 'Broadcast automation') so this automation operating mode maps to its actual concept cluster.
Replaced duplicate item 'ASR' (already present as 'Automatic speech recognition (ASR)') with 'Text-based editing', a distinct relevant neighbor.
Changed 'a spare mic' to 'a separate mic'; 'spare' wrongly connotes a backup/unused mic, contradicting the dedicated separately-channeled meaning. FK 4.8.
Added missing determiner: 'so that individual element can be reviewed' -> 'so that the individual element can be reviewed'.
